subject.title: [Bug]: Browser interactions can exhaust model context by injecting too much page content

question: Should browser interactions default to compact, goal-shaped reads and post-action change reports, with raw or full snapshots kept as an explicit escape hatch?
rationale: Current main already has caps, an efficient snapshot mode, and generic pruning, but the remaining change alters model-facing browser tool semantics and compatibility rather than repairing a narrow established bug.

options.title: Adopt Compact Browser Default
options.body: Make compact task-relevant browser output and small action change reports the default while requiring raw/full page reads to be explicitly requested.

options.title: Keep Capped Snapshots Default
options.body: Keep the current capped snapshot behavior and treat efficient mode plus docs as the supported mitigation for now.

options.title: Fold Into Browser Roadmap
options.body: Track this under the broader browser automation and context architecture work before choosing the browser-specific default contract.

recommendation.title: Adopt Compact Browser Default
recommendation.body: Make compact task-relevant browser output and small action change reports the default while requiring raw/full page reads to be explicitly requested.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining choice is a product and browser plugin contract decision, and the strongest history signal for browser snapshot defaults and docs points to this owner.
